suggested_experiment_name: WISPy CDM (ALP compilation: CAST+Sumico, ALPS, HB, EBL, X-rays)
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, plotted as Log10 g
notes: Theory/review paper on WISP cold dark matter (ALPs and hidden photons) produced via the misalignment mechanism. It maps out cosmologically allowed DM parameter regions in the m-g plane rather than presenting a new measured exclusion limit. The exclusion contours shown (ALPS, CAST+Sumico, HB, EBL, X-rays, haloscopes) are recasts of existing experimental/astrophysical bounds, not a new measurement. No extractable numerical exclusion table is provided; couplings discussed only qualitatively (e.g. g~1e-11 to 1e-21 GeV^-1). Not a new limit. | [VISION GATE D] vision notes admit tracing a compilation envelope ('envelope of the excluded region: a roughly flat CAST+Sumico bound at g~1e-10 GeV^-1 for m < ~1 eV, transitioning near m~10-1000 eV into the steeply descending EBL/X-ray ALP-decay bounds') rather than the paper's own single curve | selector: figure_vision (sole candidate) | Vision: Figure 1 of 'WISPy Cold Dark Matter' is a compilation plot with many overlapping regions (ALPS, CAST+Sumico, HB experimental bounds plus EBL/X-ray/haloscope DM-based constraints). I traced the LOWER envelope of the excluded region: a roughly flat CAST+Sumico bound at g~1e-10 GeV^-1 for m < ~1 eV, transitioning near m~10-1000 eV into the steeply descending EBL/X-ray ALP-decay bounds (slope ~ -1.5 to -1.7 on log-log, consistent with decay-rate scaling g^2 m^3). Axis calibration: x from Log m=-9 to ~7, y from Log g=-5 to -20. Reading precision is limited because multiple exclusion regions overlap; confidence is moderate. The benchmark 'Axion models' band value is a rough estimate. | Calibration: No calibration needed
